mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Counterattack1.de: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Lately, surges in quasimorphosis have been felt at %STATION_NAME%. The liaison officer of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> told us about this. The colnodes are asking for help. Apparently, this bramfatura activity attracted %VICTIM_NAME% here. They have captured part of the station and are preparing to hold some kind of <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> there. You need to get to them and eliminate them before they finish. The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> promises a worthy reward for help.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Counterattack1.ob: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Defense1.after: The reward from the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> is already on Magnum. %STATION_NAME% will be removed from the market for some time. But people, whatever they may be, are still better than quasimorphs. Right?
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Defense1.briefing: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that quasimorphs have already appeared in certain places of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out</color> for a while, and their onslaught will weaken. It seems that they are not omnipotent either.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Defense1.details:
Details: Due to its status as the public enemy, the Civil Resistance cannot directly report that %STATION_NAME% is about to be attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%.

Our analysts revealed this information with the help of the quasimorphs themselves. They have learned to bypass the SBN filters and constantly transmit messages to the network. The Hexarchy immediately declares them fakes.

If we want to improve relations with the CR, then we should help them repel the attack.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Elimination1.afte: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> is not at all interested in details. The colnode, who was in touch with us, nodded barely and hung up. I hope the reward that awaits us in Magnum's cargo hold was worth the effort.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Elimination1.brie: The sensors are almost completely blind: we observe unimaginable leaps of quasimorphosis. We'll drop you off wherever we can. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill the Duke</color>. Don't try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%, it's not in the contract.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Elimination1.deta:
Details: the Civil Resistance has become active around %STATION_NAME%. They want to get this place, but are not yet ready for direct actions. They can be understood: %STATION_NAME% is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. They somehow learned to linger in our reality for a long time. We can test the strength of their defenses.

The rebels found out that a quasimorph of the Duke type was seen at %STATION_NAME%. If we manage to eliminate it, then the forces of this faction here will be significantly weakened.

Of course, we are not doing this to save humanity. The customer indicated that the PMC that undertakes this work will receive a good reward.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Escort1.after: As a reward for saving the key colnode, the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> sent us a valuable parcel of equipment expropriated from corporations. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Escort1.briefing: Escort the colnode to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the key colnode to the safe location.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Escort1.details:
Details: The headquarters of the Civil Resistance key colnode is located at %STATION_NAME%. Recently, they have carried out several successful operations against quasimorphs. And now %VICTIM_NAME% is about to attack the station.

If we take on this urgent contract, we need to bring the key colnode to the safe location.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Escort1.objective: Another day, another mission against the quasimorphs. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the key colnode to the safe location.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Espionage1.after: The meeting with the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> colnode took place. Seeing them gives me the uncanny valley effect. It's good that they got off Magnum. We received a valuable cargo in exchange for a useless rock.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Espionage1.briefi:
The signature of igvalite has been found, its location is marked on your map. Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. The rebels are really ready to reward you well for this rock.

We will try to drop you off as close to the place as possible, but we can’t promise anything: the shuttle pilot reports strange visions.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Espionage1.detail:
Details: the Civil Resistance is conducting operations related to %STATION_NAME%. Despite the suppression of information by the Hexarchy, it is known that this place is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. The rebels discovered something interesting there.

The agents picked up the signature of an igvalite - a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It appears that the quasimorphs use this location to store energy. We have work to do.

The CR offers to infiltrate %STATION_NAME% and pick up the igvalite.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Espionage1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.af: A large number of colnodes are arriving at %STATION_NAME%. We got what we were due: the cargo is already on Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.br:
We don't know why exactly these quasimorphs remain in our reality. As a rule, the quasimorphosis subsides soon after the violence stops. But %VICTIM_NAME% has learned to overcome this limitation. You'll have to work manually.

After disembarking, methodically move forward through %STATION_NAME% and shoot everything that moves. Keep your eyes open and try to be prepared for any turn of events. Good luck.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.de:
Details: More and more quasimorphic events are happening throughout the Solar System. All such cases are presented by the corporation as fakes of the Civil Resistance. The rebels got in touch with us and urge us not to believe the lies of the corporations. They want to recruit us to recapture %STATION_NAME% from the quasimorphs. After our victory, they will look there for evidence of the existence of quasimorphs in order to provide them to all of humanity.

Here is what we will need to do: walk through %STATION_NAME% and kill as many quasimorphs as possible. These creatures act on behalf of %VICTIM_NAME% and it is unknown how they learned to linger in physical reality for a long time.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Robbery1.after: The quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% clearly did not expect such a raid. We managed to quickly leave %STATION_NAME% before the quasimorphosis began to affect Magnum. The colnodes took the junk that we carried out for them. In exchange, they handed over some equipment expropriated from corporations.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Robbery1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Task</color>: find and pick up valuable items on each floor of the station. Smash and destroy everything you want, but take the goods. After that, evacuate.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Robbery1.details:
For almost a hundred years now, the Civil Resistance has been waging a desperate struggle against corporations. Humanity is enslaved. But recently, a new source of hope for the rebels has appeared in the Solar System. We are talking about %VICTIM_NAME%. %STATION_NAME% has been captured by these monsters. And this is an unexpected trump card for the CR in the fight against corporations.

If we manage to steal valuable goods from the quasimorphs, the rebels will use them against capitalists.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Robbery1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> On each floor of %STATION_NAME%, pick up valuable items, then evacuate.
mission.CivilRes_Tezctlan_Control1.after: It turns out that %VICTIM_NAME% is not omnipotent at all. Sooner or later, not only corporate, but also spiritual oppressors will be expelled from the Solar System.
mission.CivilRes_Tezctlan_Control1.brief: The server location is marked on your map. The quasimorphs are already at %STATION_NAME%. Eliminate them all. The <color=#FFFEC1>equipment must survive</color>.
mission.CivilRes_Tezctlan_Control1.detai: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> has seriously strengthened at %STATION_NAME%. Comrades carried out several successful operations from here against %VICTIM_NAME%. However, the monsters gathered for a counterattack. The rebels report that the target will be the station's server equipment. If we want to get a reward, we need to <color=#FFFEC1>prevent the quasimorphs from destroying the computer</color>.
mission.CivilRes_Tezctlan_Counterattack1: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> colnodes have already transferred the reward to Magnum. It seems that calm times will not come to the Solar System very soon. How many corporations and factions are there fighting for dominance and survival?

It will not be possible to drop you off close to the ritual site. At %STATION_NAME% there has been a real massacre for several days. We'll have to hurry. The quasimorphs must be stopped before the ritual is completed.
<color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
